posts.author: MrOblivionZX
posts.body: Hello everyone, I am MrOblivionZX, Ive had RPG Maker MZ for a while but I never joined the forum and since then as I joined the forum I just wanted to say hello to everyone! Im still very new at this kinda stuff but I hope I can make an actual game with the engine someday!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
I started with MZ about 3.5 years ago with no prior experience and although I haven't finished a game yet, I have learned a ton and it has been a blast. A few important things are to learn how to use the tool and work on things that interest you.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
